content: Yaa Nowa alonau ge bwasumu totounuwal ge bekikil wagaa, Yabowaine nige i nunuluwagil. Inoke i ba mana i towa panayawiya, yaka wewel i taltal lau.
He iyaka wewel bwabwatana nige al i sasani heem bilibili gamwanaa ge kehe nige al i mamaligin laulau.
Inoke wewel iyoho i taltal lau. Lan ali gewi 150 i mowasi wewel iyaka i lau,
inoke weikena seben-ina ana lan sebentin-ina elana, waga i buntal labi Alalat oyana etega elana.
Wewel iyoho i taltal lau, yaka weikena elulutega ana lan houwan elana oya pwataliya hi hopit.
Lan poti al i mowasi, Nowa waga ana windo toto iyaka i ginol i pwela
ge okok i patuna i you tagil. Nige i sisikal wagaa, he i youyou pwatpwat ya ana siga wewel i mowasi ge bilibili i kevakeva.
Yaka bunibuni al i patuna i tagil ge ni atena ebo wewel iyaka i tal lau ge bilibili i dato.

Yaa wewel iyoho ya i bwayabwaya bilibili i yayabom, inoke bunibuni nige wana abayoutal i pwapwawa. Yaka i you sikal i na wagaa, inoke Nowa nimana i paelu tagilan yaka bwasumu i youtala ge i teli tukan.
Nowa i matamatan al lan seben i mowasi, yaka bunibuni i patuna al i tagil.
Kokoyaviya bunibuni i you sikal Nowa elana, he olibe lamwana kolena etega i alahikan awanaa. Inoke Nowa i atena te wewel iyaka i tal lau.
Inoke i matamatan al lan seben i mowasi, yaka abwe bunibuni i patuna al i tagil. Yaa sauga toto o nige i yoyou sikal Nowa elana.
Nowa wana baliman 601, weikena houwan ana lan houwan elana, wewel iyaka i tal lau ge bilibili i dato. Yaka Nowa waga pwatana i pwela yoho, inoke matana i nok i kite bilibili pwatana iyaka i dato.
He weikena eluwana ana lan tuwenti seben-ina (27-ina) elana bilibili iyaka i kevakeva hot.
Yaka Yabowaine i baek Nowa elana i ba,
“Alomwau lagom, natumwau ge lagoliyau waga ku loluwai ku tagil noleleya.
Bwasumu bolo hi youyou, bolo hi nawanawa ge bolo hi yawayawal, gegewel nu ahel alomwau nuku tagil tola. Inoke heliya abwe nihi talaabab ge nihi gewi, yaka nihi debalala panayawiya.”
Yaka Nowa alonau lagona, natunau ge lagoliyau, waga hi loluwai hi tagil noleleya.
Yaka bwasumu bolo hi nawanawa, bolo hi yawayawal ge bolo hi youyou, tomaha ge tomaha ali pwahin elana hi tagilem wagaa.
Yehoba wana Bateli Nowa elana
Yaka Nowa pat i pahe abapowon i ginol ge ni tapwalolo Yehoba elana. Yaka bwasumu bolo bosowaina powon, bolo hi nawanawa ge bolo hi youyou, enuna i ahel ge i powon pwabwaligel Yehoba elana.

Yehoba powon bwalena i hago ge i awa wawaisian, yaka atena elana i ba, “Bwagana gamagalau nuwatu nanakina ya te hi nuwanuwatu-an ateliyaa, i telipunaa wali sauga wawaya elana, he nige al na babaa ge panayawi na aapanak wali ginol nanakina kaiwena. Ge nige al bwasumu gegewel na aapapanak-agil ni oola toto iyaka ya ginol.

content.text: ni gangan ya nige ni momowasi.”
